name: Florida Big & Blind & Time 2022

venue.name: Black Belt Center
venue.details: Venue is a martial arts studio, enter through the double black doors, overflow parking is across the street at Publix

information: For Safety Precautions, we ask that competitors and their one guest only be in the venue during the competition's scheduled time. * Please review the COVID precautions tab for information regarding the steps taken to increase competitor safety at this competition. * Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. * Please review the competitor information tab before the competition. **STAFF** Please contact us if you are interested. You must be able to staff for the entire competition. Staff will pay registration and have it refunded upon completion of staffing for the competition.
